name: Distortion Loss with Power Transformation
definition: A modification of the mip-NeRF 360 distortion loss that applies the Power Transformation P to metric distance before computing the loss. This curves metric distance to aggressively penalize 'floaters' near the camera.
summary: Distortion Loss with Power Transformation modifies metric distance to aggressively penalize floaters near the camera, improving video quality by altering the penalty space rather than backpropagation gradients.
